name: Marshall Dry Goods Co Inc
old_description: Marshall Dry Goods has been a trusted name in fabric since 1944, proudly serving quilters, retailers, and crafters across the country. Our focus on quality, value, and service has made us a go-to source for wholesale fabrics of all kinds.
about:
Marshall Dry Goods Co., Inc. is based in Batesville, Arkansas. The company was founded in 1944 by Hassel Marshall as a dry goods store selling clothing, blankets, and a modest fabric selection. In 1985, Marshall Bentley and his father, Larry Bentley, took over operations, and the business remains under Bentley family ownership today. Marshall Bentley, the current owner, gradually shifted the company to focus entirely on fabric.

Today the company designs, prints, and manufactures more than 5,000 fabric SKUs, specializing in 100% cotton prints offered in 45-inch and 108-inch widths. Production uses both conventional rotary and digital printing methods, supporting a library of over 4,000 exclusive designs with new patterns released weekly. In addition to cotton prints, the mill produces vintage muslins, Indonesian and Indian batiks, flannel, minky, fleece, broadcloth, and quilt batting in 80/20 cotton-poly, 100% cotton, and 100% polyester, available in widths from 45 to 120 inches.

Marshall Dry Goods serves quilters, crafters, and retail fabric shops across the United States through its online store and a brick-and-mortar location in Batesville. A wholesale division supplies bulk fabric to retailers and other businesses, while the adjacent Marshall’s Quilt House provides a retreat space for quilting groups.

The company emphasizes quality fabrics at competitive prices with fast delivery, a commitment maintained since its transition to a dedicated fabric manufacturer in the 1980s.
